# 1. Overview
Maps the institutional nodes of German biomedical research—university hospitals, comprehensive cancer centers, Max Planck Institutes, and Helmholtz centers (DKFZ, MDC, DZNE)—examining:
- Institutional grant volumes across EKFS and DFG
- Cross-institution coauthorship ties
- Topical specialization and funder enrichment across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and cardiology
